events.evidence: The U.S. military shoots down an Iranian Shahed 139 drone on approach to the aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln
Several Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Navy gunboats attempt to stop and seize a U.S. tanker in the Strait of Hormuz
Armed bandits kill at least 170 people in the village of Woro in Kwara State, Nigeria

label.note: Iran-U.S. Hormuz incidents, Russian strikes, and mass killing in Nigeria sharply raise risk.
